name: kql-union
description: UNION is a row-wise union of independent solution branches (KIP §3.4.7.3): branches are deduplicated, an empty conjunctive main branch does not erase them, a branch's own patterns equi-join, and a FILTER placed after the UNION applies to the merged set. ORDER BY is added only to fix row order.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?t { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "PairNode"} } CONCEPT ?p1 { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "p1"} } CONCEPT ?p2 { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "p2"} } CONCEPT ?a1 { {type: "PairNode", name: "A1"} } CONCEPT ?a2 { {type: "PairNode", name: "A2"} } CONCEPT ?b1 { {type: "PairNode", name: "B1"} } CONCEPT ?b2 { {type: "PairNode", name: "B2"} } PROPOSITION ?l1 { (?a1, "p1", ?b1) } PROPOSITION ?l2 { (?a2, "p1", ?b2) } PROPOSITION ?l3 { (?a1, "p2", ?b2) } PROPOSITION ?l4 { (?a2, "p2", ?b2) } }

cases.name: both branches bind the same pair, and shared rows are deduplicated
cases.command: FIND(?a.name, ?b.name) WHERE { (?a, "p1", ?b) UNION { (?a, "p2", ?b) } } ORDER BY ?a.name ASC, ?b.name ASC

cases.name: a concept-only branch stays an independent row padded with null
UNION rows survive an empty conjunctive main branch
cases.command: FIND(?a.name, ?b.name) WHERE { (?a, "p1", ?b) (?b, "p1", ?a) UNION { (?a, "p2", ?b) } } ORDER BY ?a.name ASC

cases.name: a redundant sibling pattern binding an extra variable does not drop branch rows
cases.command: FIND(?a.name, ?b.name) WHERE { (?a, "p1", ?b) ?link (?a, "p1", ?b) UNION { (?a, "p2", ?b) } } ORDER BY ?a.name ASC, ?b.name ASC

cases.name: a branch's own patterns equi-join before the union
cases.command: FIND(?a.name, ?b.name) WHERE { ?a {type: "PairNode", name: "B1"} UNION { (?a, "p1", ?b) (?a, "p2", ?b) } } ORDER BY ?a.name ASC

cases.name: a FILTER after UNION also drops main-branch rows
cases.command: FIND(?a.name, ?b.name) WHERE { (?a, "p1", ?b) UNION { (?a, "p2", ?b) } FILTER(?b.name != "B1") } ORDER BY ?a.name ASC

cases.name: a FILTER after UNION drops rows from every branch
NOT does not erase bindings still used by another branch

skip.ts: grouped aggregation — a plain column beside an aggregate — is not implemented; the engine reports KIP_3001 rather than answering wrongly. See "Coverage" in ts/kip-do/README.md.
